text:
```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2
    - name: Set up Rust
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        profile: minimal
        toolchain: stable
        override: true
    - name: Build project
      run: cargo build --release
    - name: Run tests
      run: cargo test
    - name: Check Clippy
      run: cargo clippy -- -D warnings
    - name: Add license file
      run: echo "MIT" > LICENSE
    - name: Update Cargo.toml
      run: |
        sed -i '' 's/^$/license = "MIT"/' Cargo.toml
        sed -i '' 's/^$/repository = "https:\/\/github.com\/MatrixA\/aicheck"/' Cargo.toml
        sed -i '' 's/^$/homepage = "https:\/\/github.com\/MatrixA\/aicheck"/' Cargo.toml
        sed -i '' 's/^$/keywords = ["rust", "ai", "check"]/' Cargo.toml
        sed -i '' 's/^$/categories = ["command-line-utilities"]/' Cargo.toml
    - name: Commit changes
      run: |
        git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
        git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
        git add LICENSE Cargo.toml
        git commit -m "Add missing LICENSE file and update Cargo.toml"
    - name: Push changes
      run: git push origin main
```
